name: Azeroth Companion
title: Guided Progression — Build Journey & Reliable Release Delivery
features: New optional four-step guided talent build journey: choose goals, explore branches, allocate points, review and save.
Clear Class, Spec and Hero rank-point summaries and a collapsible list of selected official talents.
Read-only build reviews include advisory source-link notices, without claiming in-game eligibility or combat performance.
Guided actions open the existing planner, Path Navigator and Talent Forge save workflow; existing saves and undo remain intact.
Discord release delivery now waits longer for GitHub Pages publication and avoids uncertain network retries that could post duplicates.
